text:
sam: heads up — during the canary for the new streaming proxy sampler we saw a big gap in partial-frame metrics in the console :eyes:
ingrid: gap as in missing events or just not showing up on the heatmap?
maria: missing counts, not just visualization. requests show as active on the edge but `sse.partial_frames` is ~0 for a bunch of tenants.
sam: exactly. happened right after we flipped the proxy sampling to 0.1 for low-volume shards. canary id: canary-2026-03-sampler
ingrid: did the proxy change also alter routing? sticky -> shard-aware fallthrough?
sam: yeah we moved to a probabilistic sampler inside the edge that sometimes routes to a lightweight proxy chain that strips chunk headers to save CPU.
tom: oh — the lightweight proxies don't emit the `partial_frame` telemetry because they assume downstream reassembly. that was the tradeoff.
maria: that's bad. our billing + health dashboards rely on partial_frame as a signal for streaming health. when those disappear, alerts don't fire and console shows green.
ingrid: can we incrementally add a shim metric at the proxy ingress that approximates partial frames by counting socket write bursts? not perfect but better than nothing.
sam: added a quick patch locally to the sampler: emit `proxy.estimated_partial_frames` when `sse.fragmentation_header` missing. here's the log line I used:
```
proxy[stream]: tenant=acct-42 shard=sh-9 est_partial=124 sample=0.1 route=light-proxy
```
maria: that's a good stopgap. but it skews quota-metering if we use estimates for billing. we need separate telemetry for "safety health" vs "billing accuracy".
tom: agree. split signals: `sse.partial_frames.health` (estimated allowed) and `sse.partial_frames.billing` (only from full proxies).
ingrid: console UX note — heatmap should not drop to blank when health metric present but billing metric absent. should show a dotted outline or tooltip: "billing-accurate metric missing (using estimate)". cc @product-ux?
sam: filed ENG-STREAM-145 with screenshots and proposed tooltip copy.
observability-bot: alert created ENG-STREAM-145 (priority: P2) — assignee: ingrid
maria: next: routing policy. the lightweight chain is cheaper but increases variance in observed token counts. for quota smoothing we need deterministic routing at the start of a session. otherwise quota windowing misattributes tokens across shards.
tom: we can hash session-id -> prefer full-proxy for first 5s then allow downgraded proxy after warmup. that keeps billing anchored.
ingrid: downside: more CPU for short-lived sessions. but most of our sessions are long-lived; we should make the warmup threshold config per-tenant.
sam: rollout suggestion: feature-flag warmup-by-default for paid tiers, opt-in for free tiers. run canary for 48h with telemetry patches.
maria: also add a console toggle to surface sample-rate and whether estimates are in use per-route. ops needs quick triage without opening tickets.
ingrid: +1. add tracing header `x-rw-sampler` with `sampled/est:1` so we can correlate traces with estimated metrics.
sam: will add header and push a canary tomorrow morning.
maria: checklist before flip: 1) emit `proxy.estimated_partial_frames` 2) add `sse.partial_frames.{health,billing}` split 3) implement session warmup routing 4) console indicator for estimates 5) trace header correlation 6) run 48h canary and validate alerts
tom: I'll own warmup routing and quota smoothing change.
ingrid: I'll own telemetry and console indicators.
sam: I'll own the canary rollout and coordinate with infra for capacity.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary: canary-2026-03-sampler will start 2026-03-22T08:00Z, duration 48h.
maria: one more edge-case: proxies that do TLS termination pool-shared sockets — their write burst heuristic undercounts multi-tenant multiplexing. we'll need tenant-level accounting at ingress to avoid cross-tenant bleed.
ingrid: put that in ENG-STREAM-146 (follow-up).
sam: great — thanks everyone. please add short notes to the ticket if you hit gaps during canary.
maria: noted. starting dashboard PR to show both metrics on same tile with an icon legend. :thumbsup:
_archive_note: generated slack thread about streaming telemetry sampling and routing tradeoffs
